purpose: Make audit, deficiency mapping, collaborative repair strategy, reciprocal world-development requirements, and reference-class excellence review one durable preconstruction record so H-Earth construction cannot begin from an unexamined visual idea or silently lose known deficiencies.

tier1.name: RECIPROCAL_WORLD_DEVELOPMENT
tier1.question: Does the regional environment and planetary representation still describe one canonical place at their appropriate scales?

tier2.name: REFERENCE_AND_EXCELLENCE_AUDIT
tier2.question: Against project goals, preserved strengths, direct inspection evidence, and reference-class standards, what prevents the current artifact from reading as believable and exceptional?

tier3.name: DEFICIENCY_TO_STRATEGY_PRECONSTRUCTION_CUSTODY
tier3.question: Has every accepted deficiency been mapped to a collaborative repair strategy and frozen into the same record before construction begins?

deficiencyRegister.title: SECOND_BOX_BOUNDARY_READ
deficiencyRegister.finding: The world-continuation repair remains visibly legible as an expanded outer box around the authored region.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: No readable perimeter line, shelf, wall, rectangular horizon cue, or tonal/elevation discontinuity may disclose the continuation mechanism.

deficiencyRegister.title: ENVIRONMENTAL_TRANSITION_NOT_BLEND_COHERENT
deficiencyRegister.finding: The exterior continuation does not sufficiently inherit local slope, shoreline direction, material frequency, atmosphere, and terrain character before attenuating into distance.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: The visible world must transition continuously from authored detail into lower-frequency distant representation without an obvious layer boundary.

deficiencyRegister.title: DESERT_READING_CONTRADICTS_SUBTROPICAL_IDENTITY
deficiencyRegister.finding: The current material palette, exposed soil dominance, weak vegetation density, and sparse biome differentiation make Gratitude read as arid/desert-like rather than subtropical.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: Ground-scale climate, vegetation, material, moisture, and atmospheric cues must collectively read as a warm subtropical coastal region.

deficiencyRegister.title: WEAK_HYDROLOGY_VEGETATION_MATERIAL_CAUSALITY
deficiencyRegister.finding: Vegetation and material expression are not yet strongly correlated with drainage, valleys, exposure, elevation, freshwater proximity, slope, and coastal conditions.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: Environmental distribution must arise from local geographic causes rather than uniform decorative greening.

deficiencyRegister.title: GRATITUDE_MACRO_MORPHOLOGY_TOO_BLOB_LIKE
deficiencyRegister.finding: Although local coast geometry is improving, Gratitude's macro disposition remains too round and blob-like to serve as a believable continental positional standard.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: Regional proof must expose enough asymmetric coastal, relief, drainage, and directional structure to support a later non-blob planetary morphology reconstruction.

deficiencyRegister.title: RISK_OF_OVERFITTING_LOCAL_ENVIRONMENT_TO_PROVISIONAL_SHAPE
deficiencyRegister.finding: If biome, hydrology, or continuation systems are keyed to the current silhouette, later correction of Gratitude's planetary shape will force avoidable regression.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: Environmental systems must be driven primarily by local causal fields and climate relationships, not by hard-coded dependence on the provisional outer silhouette.

deficiencyRegister.title: ENVIRONMENTAL_RECIPROCITY_NOT_YET_FIRST_CLASS
deficiencyRegister.finding: The existing reciprocal baseline strongly governs geography but does not yet make climate, biome, hydrology, vegetation distribution, atmosphere, and material identity equally explicit comparison dimensions.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: Future globe and regional qualification must compare both geographic identity and environmental identity.

deficiencyRegister.title: GRATITUDE_NOT_YET_READY_AS_AUDRALIA_POSITIONAL_STANDARD
deficiencyRegister.finding: The region is not yet sufficiently believable in shape, geography, environmental causality, and scale to constrain the later shape of the wider Audralia continent.
deficiencyRegister.acceptanceNeed: A believable regional standard must be established before Gratitude is used to derive surrounding continental composition on the globe.
